config.paperSize.description: Output paper size. 'original' grows the page around the source at 100% (landscape pages get the note area below, portrait pages to the right). A named size (ISO A/B, Letter, Legal, Tabloid, Ledger) fixes the page and scales the source to fit; the sheet is upright for landscape sources and sideways for portrait ones. Tablet entries are the device's logical screen size (the same page Ipynb PDF Converter produces).
config.layoutMode.description: Note layout. 'feedback' (landscape pages only) adds the feedback banner under the source and a vertical divider splitting the note area in two.
config.layoutMode.enum.1: Feedback: banner image under the source plus a left/right divider (landscape pages)
config.feedbackBannerImage.description: Banner image for feedback mode (feedback-label.jpeg in pdf2note.py): a path relative to the source file, an absolute path or an http(s) URL. Empty = divider only.
config.lineGap.description: Spacing of the ruled lines in pt on an A4-portrait body; scaled with the page like every other dimension.
config.headerText.description: Header drawn in the band above the body. Placeholders: {file}, {date}, {page}, {total}. Empty = no header band.
config.footerText.description: Footer drawn in a band below the body. Placeholders: {file}, {date}, {page}, {total}. Empty = no footer band.
config.headerFooterFontSize.description: Header/footer font size in pt on an A4-portrait body (10 in pdf2note.py); scaled with the page. The band is 1.5× this size.
config.outputDirectory.description: Where the note PDF is written. Empty = next to the source file. A relative path is resolved from the source file's folder; absolute paths work too. Created if missing.
config.outputFileName.description: Output file name without extension. Placeholders: {name} (source file name without extension), {date} (YYYY-MM-DD). An existing file is never overwritten: "name (1).pdf", "name (2).pdf", …
config.openAfterConvert.description: Open the note PDF in the system viewer when done.
config.pdfPassword.description: Default password for the '… with Password' commands. Leave empty to be prompted each time. The plain commands never apply it. Stored in plain text in settings. Encryption is AES-256.
config.pdfPermissions.description: What a reader who opens an encrypted PDF with the password may do. Default = ipynb-pdf-converter's rule: annotations and form filling only (no printing, copying or editing).
config.ownerPassword.description: Owner password of encrypted PDFs, which unlocks everything pdfPermissions denies. Empty = the same as the PDF password (pdfPassword, or the one typed in the prompt). Note that the limits then do not bind anyone who knows that password.
config.teacherMode.description: Adds the hossam / jussam commands (each with and without password) to the context menus and palette. They draw the instructor mark (https://data.hossam.kr/itwill-ho.png or itwill-ju.png, 100 pt wide) at the top right of every page in place of headerText.
config.paperSize.enum.0: Original size (grow the page around the source)
config.paperSize.enum.22: iPad / iPad Air 11" (2360 × 1640 px panel; same size)
config.paperSize.enum.24: Galaxy Tab S11 11" (2560 × 1600 px panel; S12 11" expected to match)
config.paperSize.enum.25: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra / S12 Ultra 14.6" (2960 × 1848 px panel; same size)
